name: ds-ai-coding-skills
description: Agent skills for data scientists: the diagnostic figures and values that must accompany each analysis method

plugins.name: ds-diagnostics
plugins.description: Run a statistical / ML / causal / simulation method and get its diagnostics with it: required figures, required values and a verdict table. 5 routers, 19 method references.

plugins.name: skill-ablation
plugins.description: Check which instructions in your skills are still needed: run the same prompts without the skill, with one line in AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, and with the full skill, count the required outputs, and prune what makes no difference.
